lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Move issues on the project issue tracker through a small state machine of triage roles.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: If this repo treats external pull requests as a request surface (see the issue-tracker config), triage covers them too: **a PR is an issue with attached code** — same roles, same states, same machine, with a few deltas marked "for a PR" below. Resolve a bare `#42` to an issue or PR per the tracker config.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Every comment or issue posted to the issue tracker during triage **must** start with this disclaimer:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > *This was generated by AI during triage.*

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - [AGENT-BRIEF.md](AGENT-BRIEF.md) — how to write durable agent briefs

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `needs-info` — waiting on reporter for more information

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `ready-for-agent` — fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: For a PR, the same states read against the attached code: `ready-for-agent` means a brief is attached and an agent should take the next step on the diff; `ready-for-human` means it's ready for a human to merge.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Every triaged issue should carry exactly one category role and one state role. If state roles conflict, flag it and ask the maintainer before doing anything else.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: These are canonical role names — the actual label strings used in the issue tracker may differ. The mapping should have been provided to you - run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` if not.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: State transitions: an unlabeled issue normally goes to `needs-triage` first; from there it moves to `needs-info`, `ready-for-agent`, `ready-for-human`, or `wontfix`. `needs-info` returns to `needs-triage` once the reporter replies. The maintainer can override at any time — flag transitions that look unusual and ask before proceeding.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The maintainer invokes `/triage` and describes what they want in natural language. Interpret the request and act. Examples:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "Show me anything that needs my attention"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "What's ready for agents to pick up?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Query the issue tracker and present three buckets, oldest first:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 3. **`needs-info` with reporter activity since the last triage notes** — needs re-evaluation.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: When PRs are in scope, include external PRs in these buckets and tag each line `[PR]` or `[issue]`. Discovery surfaces only *external* PRs (the tracker config defines who counts as external) — a collaborator's in-flight PR is not triage work. This filter is discovery-only; an explicitly named PR is always triaged regardless of author.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Show counts and a one-line summary per item. Let the maintainer pick.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Triage a specific issue or PR

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 1. **Gather context.** Read the full issue or PR (body, comments, labels, author, dates; for a PR, the diff too). Parse any prior triage notes so you don't re-ask resolved questions. Explore the codebase using the project's domain glossary, respecting ADRs in the area. Run two checks against the codebase: (a) **redundancy** — search for an existing implementation of the requested behavior by domain concept (not just the request's wording), and report where you looked. If found, it's an already-implemented `wontfix` (step 5). (b) **prior rejection** — read `.out-of-scope/*.md` and surface any that resembles this request.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 2. **Recommend.** Tell the maintainer your category and state recommendation with reasoning, plus a brief codebase summary relevant to the request — including whether it's already implemented. Wait for direction.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 3. **Verify the claim.** Before any grilling, check that the claim holds up. For a bug, reproduce it from the reporter's steps. For a PR, confirm the diff does what it claims — check it out, run the relevant tests or commands. Report what happened: confirmed (with code path), failed, or insufficient detail (a strong `needs-info` signal). A confirmed verification makes a much stronger agent brief.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 4. **Grill (if needed).** If the request needs fleshing out, run the `/grilling` and `/domain-modeling` skills together — grill it into shape one question at a time, sharpening domain terms and updating `CONTEXT.md`/ADRs inline as decisions land.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `ready-for-human` — same structure as an agent brief, but note why it can't be delegated (judgment calls, external access, design decisions, manual testing).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `wontfix` — close, with the comment depending on *why*:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Already implemented** — the change already exists in the codebase. Point to where it lives; do **not** write to `.out-of-scope/` (that KB is for *rejected* requests, not built ones).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Rejected (enhancement)** — write to `.out-of-scope/`, link to it from a comment, then close ([OUT-OF-SCOPE.md](OUT-OF-SCOPE.md)).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `needs-triage` — apply the role. Optional comment if there's partial progress.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: If the maintainer says "move #42 to ready-for-agent", trust them and apply the role directly. Confirm what you're about to do (role changes, comment, close), then act. Skip grilling. If moving to `ready-for-agent` without a grilling session, ask whether they want to write an agent brief.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Capture everything resolved during grilling under "established so far" so the work isn't lost. Questions must be specific and actionable, not "please provide more info".

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: If prior triage notes exist on the issue or PR, read them, check whether the reporter has answered any outstanding questions, and present an updated picture before continuing. Don't re-ask resolved questions.
